description: Use this when the user asks how long a text is, for example "how many words is this", "character count for this tweet", "will this fit in one SMS", "how long does this take to read". Input tips: pass text exactly as written, up to 20,000 characters (about 3,500 words); do not trim or fix it. Returns: characters, characters without spaces, graphemes (user-perceived characters), words, sentences, paragraphs, lines, UTF-8 bytes, SMS encoding, units and segments, reading minutes, and Flesch reading ease and grade (English only, null otherwise), with the rule used for each count. Not for: counting text inside a file, PDF or spreadsheet the tool cannot see (paste the text instead), or counting tokens for a model. Errors: a text over the limit is refused; split it and add the counts. The text is not stored.

text.description: The text to count, exactly as the user wrote it (at most 20000 characters, about 3,500 words).

name: count_text

characters.description: Unicode code points; an emoji counts as 1.

characters_no_spaces.description: Code points that are not whitespace.

flesch_kincaid_grade.description: Flesch-Kincaid US school grade level; null for non-English text or text with no sentence.

flesch_reading_ease.description: Flesch Reading Ease, higher is easier (60 to 70 is plain English); null for non-English text or text with no sentence.

graphemes.description: Characters as a reader sees them; an emoji with a skin tone is 1.

lines.description: Lines separated by a line break.

paragraphs.description: Blocks of text separated by blank lines.

reading_minutes.description: Silent reading time in minutes at 238 words a minute, one decimal.

rules.description: The rule behind each count, to quote when the user asks what counts as a word or a character.

characters_no_spaces.description: How characters without spaces are counted.

flesch.description: How the Flesch scores are counted.

sms.description: How SMS units and segments are counted.

sentences.description: Sentences, split with English sentence rules.

sms.description: How a carrier would send the text as SMS.

encoding.description: GSM-7 for the basic alphabet, UCS-2 when any other character is present.

segments.description: Messages the text is split into: 1 when it fits in 160 GSM-7 or 70 UCS-2 units.

units.description: Encoding units used; a GSM extension character such as the euro sign counts 2.

utf8_bytes.description: Size of the text in UTF-8 bytes.

words.description: Runs of non-whitespace; a hyphenated word or a number is 1 word.

title: Count words and characters
